title: Incidence and Complications of Atrial Fibrillation in a Low Socioeconomic and High Disability United States (US) Population: A Combined Statistical and Machine Learning Approach.
summary: In US Medicaid data, statistical and machine-learning analyses grouped people by socioeconomic status and disability and compared those groups with atrial-fibrillation incidence and complications. The reported associations are observational and do not establish that socioeconomic or disability status causes AF.
ai_technology: Statistical clustering and machine-learning analyses characterized joint socioeconomic/disability groups and their AF incidence patterns.
